verdict.rationale: Evidence shows monday.com offers many third-party integrations (Salesforce, HubSpot, Zendesk, GitHub, etc.) and flexible APIs/SDKs that could be used to move data in from other tools, but there is no explicit mention of an import wizard, CSV import, or dedicated 'migrate from X' onboarding flow for switching PMs. Missing for 10: explicit import/migration tooling (e.g., CSV/board import, one-click migration from competitor PM tools), independent confirmation that data import actually works smoothly during onboarding.
